CPRGEN.noGM: No GM is connected to validate the action.
CPRGEN.denied: You are not allowed to use the generator on this sheet.

create.title: New character
create.body: A new character sheet will be created and the generator opened. To let a player complete it, give them owner permission on it.

rollPolicy.name: Generator rolls
rollPolicy.hint: With «Roll or choose», every step that allows a roll also allows choosing the result, as the rulebook permits. With «Rolls only», you must roll, and rerolling needs GM approval. All rolls go to chat.

playersEnabled.name: Players can use the generator
playersEnabled.hint: Only on character sheets they own. Players never create new sheets: the GM creates the sheet and gives them ownership.

wizard.title: Generator — {name}
wizard.resetBody: Everything chosen in the generator for this sheet will be deleted. The RED sheet does not change.
wizard.pending: This step is not available yet for this method in this version of the generator.
wizard.needRole: Choose a role first in the «Role» step.

method.intro: Choose how to create the character. The method sets how stats, skills and gear are obtained. Changing it later discards your choices.
method.changeBody: Changing the method discards everything chosen so far in the generator. Continue?

streetrat.label: Streetrat
streetrat.hint: Fastest. Stats rolled on the role table; skills, weapons, armor, gear and cyberware set by role, plus 500eb.

edgerunner.label: Edgerunner
edgerunner.hint: Stats rolled on the role table; buy skills with points; weapons, armor, gear and cyberware from the role lists, plus 500eb.

complete.label: Complete Package
complete.hint: Buy stats (2 to 8) and skills (max 6) with points, and spend 2550eb on weapons, armor, gear and cyberware and 800eb on fashion and cyberfashion.

reroll.title: Reroll
reroll.ask: {user} asks to reroll a generator roll on {actor}: {what}. Allow it?
reroll.denied: The GM does not let {user} reroll: {what}.
reroll.locked: With «Rolls only», rerolling needs GM approval.

role.intro: Choose the character's role. It starts with its role ability at 4.
role.changeBody: Changing role discards everything that depends on it (stats, skills, gear and role lifepath). The general lifepath is kept. Continue?

stats.introStreetrat: Roll 1d10 and copy that row of your role template, in order.
stats.introEdgerunner: Roll 1d10 for each stat separately and take that row's value in its column of your role template.

skills.introStreetrat: Streetrat skills are set by role. Just choose the listed specialties and your cultural origin language.
skills.suggestedNone: Roll or choose your cultural origin in «Lifepath» to see your region's languages.
skills.introEdgerunner: Spend {budget} points among your role's 20 skills. Each must end between {min} and {max}. Skills marked (x2) cost 2 points per level. The origin language (level 4) is free.

lifepath.intro: Go through the general and role lifepath. Tables can be rolled; decisions are chosen.

gear.intro: Starting gear is set by role. Where there are options, choose one. You also get 500eb.
gear.humanity: The book computes a Humanity loss of {loss} ({emp} EMP) for this cyberware; RED's average loss is applied on install.

review.applied: Already applied to the sheet on {date}.
review.note: Applying writes stats, skills, lifepath, money and housing, and adds the role, gear and installed cyberware (with its Humanity loss). Nothing is deleted from the sheet.

missing.statsEach: {n} stats not rolled or chosen (Stats step).
missing.skills: The skill spread exceeds the available points (Skills step).

apply.missingItem: Item {uuid} not found in the RED compendia.
apply.againBody: This character was already applied. Applying again adds the role, gear and cyberware again (duplicates). Continue?
apply.title: Apply to sheet
apply.body: The character will be written to the RED sheet. Continue?

log.stats: Stats, Humanity, lifepath and lifestyle written.
log.skillMissing: Skill {name} not found on the sheet.
log.clothingMissing: Clothing {name} not found in the RED compendium.
log.noFoundation: {name} has no foundational cyberware of its type; installed directly on the body.

apply.noCoreSkills: The sheet lacks RED core skills. Create the sheet from the actors directory (or the generator button) and apply again.
